changelog:
New admin panel: a top-level Lead Assistant menu with seven pages (Overview, Guided setup, Sources and documentation, Requests, Unanswered questions, Appearance with a live widget preview, Settings). The old Settings > WP Lead Assistant address redirects to the Overview. Settings, keys, sources and requests are kept.
Code follows the WordPress Coding Standards and PHPCompatibilityWP, checked in CI. Uninstall no longer overwrites a WordPress global variable; table names go through `$wpdb->prepare()` placeholders.
Plugin Check passes with no errors on the ZIP, checked in CI (the update checker for aiframe.it is excluded until the WordPress.org build). The "coming soon" labels in the panel are escaped before output.
Fixed: saving the AI provider no longer resets the daily AI request limit, the Anthropic workspace or the consent when the form does not include them.
Security reporting procedure: a Security section in this readme and the SECURITY.md file shipped in the ZIP explain how to report a vulnerability (security@aiframe.it), the response times, the scope and that only the latest beta receives fixes. No changes to how the plugin works.
